questions.question: CI/CD là gì và tại sao quan trọng?

options.B: CI: tự động build/test khi push code. CD: tự động deploy. Giảm manual errors, faster feedback, reliable releases
options.C: CI/CD chỉ dùng cho large teams
options.D: CD = Continuous Development, không phải Deployment

questions.explanation: CI (Continuous Integration): developer push code → pipeline tự động chạy: build, unit tests, integration tests, code quality. CD (Continuous Delivery): build artifact sẵn sàng deploy bất cứ lúc nào, cần manual approval. CD (Continuous Deployment): tự động deploy lên production sau khi CI pass. Lợi ích: (1) Phát hiện bugs sớm (khi code còn fresh). (2) Smaller releases (ít risk). (3) Faster time to market. (4) No manual deploy errors.

questions.question: GitHub Actions workflow file có cấu trúc thế nào?

options.A: Chỉ cần script bash là đủ
options.B: YAML file trong .github/workflows/: on (triggers), jobs (runners), steps (checkout, run, uses actions)

questions.explanation: on: push: branches: [main]. on: pull_request: types: [opened, synchronize]. on: schedule: cron. jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest. steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4. - name: Setup Node; uses: actions/setup-node@v4; with: node-version: 20. - name: Install; run: npm ci. - name: Test; run: npm test. Secrets: ${{ secrets.MY_SECRET }}. Context: ${{ github.sha }}, ${{ github.ref_name }}. Reusable workflows: call with workflow_call.

questions.question: Deployment environments thông thường là gì?

options.A: Chỉ cần 2 environments: dev và production
options.B: Development (local) → Staging (production-like, testing) → Production. Một số thêm QA, UAT, pre-prod
options.C: Nhiều environment hơn luôn tốt hơn
options.D: Staging và production có thể share database

questions.explanation: Environments: (1) Local/Development: developer's machine, mock services. (2) Staging/Pre-production: production-like environment, real integrations, end-to-end testing, load testing. (3) Production: real users, real data. Một số teams thêm: QA (quality assurance), UAT (User Acceptance Testing), Canary (small % of traffic). Staging phải giống production nhất có thể (same config, same size). Không share database giữa staging và production (data isolation).

questions.question: Blue-Green deployment và Canary deployment — khác nhau thế nào?

options.B: Blue-Green: 2 identical environments, instant switch. Canary: gradual rollout (1% → 10% → 100%), monitor metrics

questions.explanation: Blue-Green: 2 environments (blue=current, green=new). Switch load balancer. Instant rollback: switch back. Tốn: gấp đôi infrastructure. Canary: release mới cho 1-10% users trước. Monitor: error rate, latency. Nếu tốt → tăng dần. Nếu lỗi → rollback subset. Kubernetes: canary với traffic splitting (Istio, Argo Rollouts). Feature flags (LaunchDarkly): canary không cần deploy lại. A/B testing khác canary: A/B test business metrics (conversion rate), canary test technical metrics (error rate).

questions.question: Secrets management trong CI/CD — best practices?

options.B: GitHub Secrets/GitLab Variables/Vault cho secrets. Không commit secrets vào repo. OIDC cho cloud provider auth (no long-lived credentials)
options.D: Chỉ cần HTTPS là đủ để bảo vệ secrets

questions.explanation: Never commit secrets: API keys, passwords, tokens. Tools: (1) GitHub Secrets: repository/environment secrets, masked in logs. (2) HashiCorp Vault: dynamic secrets (short-lived), secret rotation. (3) AWS Secrets Manager / Parameter Store. (4) OIDC (OpenID Connect): CI runner assume IAM role mà không cần long-lived credentials (best practice cho AWS). Rotate secrets regularly. Audit access. Secret scanning: GitHub secret scanning, truffleHog — tìm secrets bị commit nhầm. .env.example không chứa real values.

questions.question: Setup CI pipeline cho Node.js project với GitHub Actions — các steps cần có?

options.B: Checkout → Install (npm ci, cache) → Lint → Type check → Test (coverage) → Build → Security audit → Notify
options.D: Pipeline chỉ cần khi merge lên main

questions.explanation: Complete CI pipeline: (1) Checkout: actions/checkout@v4. (2) Setup Node: actions/setup-node@v4 với cache: npm. (3) npm ci: deterministic install (faster than npm install). (4) npm run lint: ESLint (catch code issues). (5) npm run type-check: tsc --noEmit. (6) npm test -- --coverage: unit + integration tests. (7) npm run build: verify build works. (8) npm audit --audit-level=moderate: check vulnerabilities. (9) Upload artifacts: test coverage report. Parallel jobs: lint/type-check và tests cùng lúc. Matrix testing: multiple Node versions.

questions.question: CI pipeline fail intermittently (flaky tests). Cách xử lý?

options.A: Retry pipeline cho đến khi pass
options.B: Identify flaky tests (random failures), fix root cause (timing issues, shared state, external dependencies), quarantine flaky tests, monitor flakiness rate
options.C: Ignore failures vì chỉ là CI

questions.explanation: Flaky tests: pass/fail không deterministic với cùng code. Nguyên nhân: (1) Timing/async: test không đợi async ops xong (dùng explicit wait, not setTimeout). (2) Shared state: tests không isolate, affect nhau (dùng beforeEach cleanup). (3) External dependencies: network calls, filesystem, time (mock external deps, deterministic time). (4) Race conditions: concurrent tests. (5) Environment: different OS/Node version. Fix: Quarantine → tag flaky tests, không block PR. Monitor: track flakiness rate qua thời gian. Auto-retry: pytest-rerunfailures, jest.retryTimes (last resort). Root cause fix là ưu tiên.

questions.question: Deploy Kubernetes app với GitOps và ArgoCD — workflow?

options.B: Code push → CI build/push image → update image tag trong Git manifest repo → ArgoCD detect và sync to K8s cluster

questions.explanation: GitOps workflow: (1) Dev push code → GitHub. (2) CI (GitHub Actions): test → build Docker image → push to ECR/GCR với tag = git SHA. (3) CI update image tag trong K8s manifests repo (separate repo hoặc subfolder). (4) ArgoCD: watch manifests repo, detect change → sync to K8s cluster (apply manifests). (5) K8s rolling update: new pods → health check → old pods terminated. Benefits: Git as source of truth, audit trail, rollback = revert git commit, no kubectl on CI (security). ArgoCD sync: auto hoặc manual approval. Helm + ArgoCD: manage Helm values in Git.
